resources.string: Keep the offline VPN up while connected

Brings this app’s offline VPN up while a phone is connected. Intended for units on 2.4 GHz or with periodic audio and video stutters: it stops the head unit’s WiFi chip from looking for other networks. While it is on, other apps on this head unit have no internet. Applies on the next connection.
